messages:
maya: Heads up — planning cohorted launch posts for Redwood Inference next Tue/Wed. Goal: 3 staggered X threads + 2 LinkedIn posts targeting devs + product folks. Need final copy and hero GIF by EOD Thu.

sam: Can we stagger by timezone/cohort? e.g., NA morning, EU afternoon, APAC evening. That helped last quarter.

lina: +1 on timezone cohorts. Also suggest different CTAs per cohort — dev sandbox signups for NA, case study CTA for EU, webinar invite for APAC.

maya: Perfect. Layout I sketched:
```
Cohort A (NA): X thread 10am PT -> CTA: sandbox
Cohort B (EU): X thread 2pm CET -> CTA: case study
Cohort C (APAC): LinkedIn post 6pm JST -> CTA: webinar
```

maya: Assets needed: short carousel GIF (1), 2 static hero images, 3 tweet-length variants for each thread node, and 1 webinar landing link. @ana can you confirm creative capacity?

ana: (ana) I’m on it — can do GIF + 2 images by Thu afternoon. Need final copy asap. Any creative direction?

maya: Keep visuals focused on "predictable latency" + cost comparison chart. Colors: use product blue + dark slate. For GIF frames: 1) Redwood logo intro, 2) 2-3 token throughput chart, 3) CTA slide.

sam: For copy: short hook + benchmark stat + clear CTA. Example X opener: "Cut inference costs by 40% without sacrificing latency — here's how we did it.👇" then link thread with benchmark slide.

lina: For LinkedIn long post, we should repurpose the benchmark narrative but include customer quote and bulletized benefits. I can draft.

maya: Routing note — inbound leads from the webinar CTA should flow to SDR cohort queue A (sdr-na@redwood). Case study CTA leads to sales-ops funnel for nurture. We need Zapier mapping and UTM params.

devon: I’ll handle Zap mapping. Confirm UTM format: utm_source=x, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=cohort-launch-1717, utm_content=na_thread | eu_thread | apac_linkedin. Sound good?

sam: Looks good. Also add a hidden param to mark creative variant (gif_v1/gif_v2).

maya: Engagement fallback plan: if thread engagement < 200 interactions in 24h, we auto-run boost on top-performing node (budget $500) and trigger re-post with different hook after 18h. ops-bot, can you set an alert?

ops-bot: Alert rule created: monitor "cohort-launch-1717" mentions & interactions. Threshold=200 interactions within 24h. Notify @maya @sam @lina if below threshold.

ana: Quick Q on posting cadence — do we publish LinkedIn and X simultaneously for APAC cohort or staggered?

maya: Stagger by 30m — X first, LinkedIn 30m later for APAC. That avoids cannibalization.

lina: I'll drop the LinkedIn draft in google drive: https://drive.google.com/example-cohort-doc and tag copy changes.

maya: Great. Final checklist: copy review (lina) by Wed EOD, assets (ana) Thu EOD, UTM & zap (devon) Thu EOD, scheduling + posts queued Fri morning. Everyone ping me for blockers. :rocket:
